svg.title: When an authenticated request may retry
svg.desc: Concurrent refreshes share one attempt. A single retry requires new credentials, an active request and unchanged identity; sensitive operations require a new authorization ticket. Network failures are not proof of an invalid session. Failed recovery or a failed retry is returned to the caller.
svg.metadata: flowchart TB A["Send the business request with current credentials"] B{"Recognized recoverable session failure?"} C["Share refresh; save successful credentials"] D["Explicitly invalid, with recoverSession configured?"] E["Recover the original user login and current credentials"] F["Check cancellation, identity and sensitive ticket; retry once"] G["Return the response or report failure to the caller"] A --> B B -->|"no"| G B -->|"yes"| C C -->|"refresh succeeds"| F C -->|"no new credentials"| D D -->|"yes"| E D -->|"no"| G E -->|"recovered"| F E -->|"cancelled / failed"| G F --> G classDef default fill:#edf3ff,stroke:#476aab,color:#172b4d,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef good fill:#e9f6ef,stroke:#28734e,color:#17452f,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef stop fill:#fff0f0,stroke:#af4040,color:#742b2b,stroke-width:1.5px; classDef pending fill:#fff6df,stroke:#a07827,color:#654b18,stroke-width:1.5px; class G good; class D pending;

text.font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC,Noto Sans CJK JP,sans-serif

svg.text: When an authenticated request may retry
